question: Which of the following foods generally increase blood pressure?

options.text: Food with low salt and low sugar
Food high in salt, sugar and saturated or trans fats

solution:
The correct answer is **__Food high in salt sugar and saturated or trans fats.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **High salt food:**

 
 
• **Fluid Retention**: Causes the body to hold onto more water, increasing blood volume and pressure.
 
• **Blood Vessel Strain**: Impairs endothelial function, reducing vessel flexibility.
 
• **Hormonal Impact: I**ncreases aldosterone levels, leading to water retention.
 
 
 
• **Saturated Fat-Rich food:**
 
 
• **Atherosclerosis**: Leads to cholesterol buildup, narrowing arteries.
 
• **Inflammation**: Causes arterial stiffness and increased pressure.
 
• **Weight Gain: **Associated with obesity, a risk factor for high blood pressure.
 
• **Insulin Resistance**: Linked to metabolic disorders that raise blood pressure.
 
 
 
• **All of the above raise blood pressure.** Reducing these in diet can help manage and lower blood pressure levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Blood Pressure ** Can be measured using a** manual sphygmomanometer or an electronic blood pressure monitor.**
 
• Measures force of blood against artery walls.
 
• **Normal range: **~**120/80 mmHg.**
 
• **Systolic: **Pressure during heartbeats (top number).
 
• **Diastolic**: Pressure between beats (bottom number).
